title: Category lists Uncategorized first, then A to Z, on both reports
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access' and 'Settings — Parts'.
  • Have two new categories for this test, category A named Aaa Test Category and category B named Zzz Test Category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Open the Category filter.
  3. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  4. Open the Category filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized is first.
  • Category A comes before category B, with the other categories A to Z.
  • Every category is ticked.

Step 3:

  • Sales by Category opens with a Category chip.

Step 4:

  • The list is the same: Uncategorized first, then A to Z.
